status: frozen_before_new_response_exposure; awaiting data-owner qualification and isolated packet
eligibility: Data owner confirms circular mean-symbol extraction, four or more distinct positive doses per curve, drug aliases, source license and final calibration QC. Source changes require a labelled input amendment before any predictions. All registered outcomes retained.
development_exposure: Only dataset/compound/endpoint/dose-count/unit/issue metadata and response presence counts were exposed; response values and images were withheld. Prior Ewart/Yuan outcomes are retrospective. Chemical novelty across EPA screens is not asserted.
splitting: Previous Ewart/Yuan drug identities go to training. Other source drug names ranked by SHA256(capacity-external-v1|name); fill training to 6, next 9 calibrate, last 6 test. Same drug membership across both endpoints.
context_indices: For L sorted distinct positive doses, use indices [0, floor((L-1)/3), floor(2*(L-1)/3)] per curve; each endpoint uses exactly three observed concentrations. Expose candidate dose metadata, conceal other responses.
preprocessing: Each endpoint keeps native published concentration and response units. No cross-endpoint pooling, no Ewart xCmax to Bircsak uM conversion, no invented Cmax. Source-native training avoids cross-source unit substitution.
model_selection: Same frozen 13 candidates. Train only on six training drugs, inner leave-one-drug-out mean MAE using the fixed three-point context rule. Enumerate all C(L,3) training designs. Exact ties within 1e-12 use original candidate order. Fit selected and fixed50 on six training drugs; interpolation remains comparator. Calibration/test drugs are absent from every model/analog/profile fit and candidate choice.
calibration: Nine separate drugs calibrate a 90% simultaneous prediction envelope: per drug take maximum absolute held-dose error across both endpoints divided by each endpoint context scale max(abs(lowest-context response), eps_endpoint). eps_endpoint=1e-6*median(abs(all training responses)), floored at 1e-12. q is sorted score ceil((9+1)*0.90)=9. Halfwidth=q*context scale. This is conditional on exchangeability of drug-level curves and targets digitized means. 95% would require the infinite sentinel at n=9.
research_decision: Per endpoint flag a 50% response reduction relative to its lowest observed dose. If an observed context value or any upper prediction bound is <= 0.5*lowest response, output report_reduction. If all observed contexts and all lower bounds are > threshold, output report_no_reduction. Otherwise output measure_next. If lowest context <=0, output measure_next and preserve the curve in MAE analysis. This is a research threshold, separate from validated clinical toxicity classification.
next_point: Among unmeasured concentrations, first prioritize intervals containing the threshold, then maximize distance in log10 concentration from the nearest measured dose; ties choose larger concentration. Uses observed values, model predictions and dose metadata only. Record next dose for every curve before revealing references.
freeze_order: data owner final QC/exposure receipt and source hashes
data owner exports train full curves, calibration full curves, test three-point values and dose metadata; retains test full response file separately
forecast owner selects on training only, freezes model/candidate choices
calibrate once on nine calibration drugs
save all test point predictions, intervals, next-dose choices and decisions; hash and timestamp manifest
data owner verifies manifest, supplies full test reference and its matching earlier hash
score all six test drugs and both endpoints once; preserve exclusions/missingness and signs; no candidate changes
reporting: Drug-macro MAE and each drug; paired differences vs fixed50 and interpolation; simultaneous envelope coverage; report/retest counts; wrong report/all curves and wrong report/reported; next-dose observed error. Native units separate, no total-chip/well savings without chip/replicate/cost IDs. External published-sequence replay, not prospective wet-lab savings.
owner_boundary: Data custodian is existing chip-digitization owner; forecast owner receives context package only until prediction manifest is sealed. Shared filesystem gives procedural/entrypoint isolation, not cryptographic access isolation. Any full-reference exposure before prediction is logged and moves those curves to retrospective analysis.
